info.title: Snapchat Public Stories API: Profiles, Stories, Highlights
info.description:
Public Snapchat profiles with their active story and curated highlights as JSON, by username.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/snapchat-public-stories (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Returns the active public stories and saved highlights of Snapchat creators: each snap's direct media link, preview image, type, title, publish time and location where shared, plus the creator's username and name. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

usernames.title: Snapchat usernames or profile URLs
usernames.description: Public Snapchat usernames, @handles, or full snapchat.com profile URLs.

includeActiveStory.title: Include active story
includeActiveStory.description: Return currently active public story snaps when the profile exposes them.

includeCuratedHighlights.title: Include curated highlights
includeCuratedHighlights.description: Return durable curated public profile highlight snaps.

maxProfiles.title: Maximum profiles
maxProfiles.description: Maximum number of supplied profiles processed in one run. A request returns 20 rows at most.

maxSnapsPerProfile.title: Maximum snaps per profile
maxSnapsPerProfile.description: Maximum active-story and curated-highlight snap rows saved for each profile.

201.description: The results, one object per row.

400.description: The request body does not fit the input fields. The message says which field.
